title: wg: room-policy-04 §8.1 when min/max constraints are evaluated
description: Suggestion. §8.1.2-8.1.3 say constraints "must be satisfied" but not per proposal or after the whole commit; a multi-proposal commit can pass one reading and fail the other. mimid evaluates once after the commit (decision mimid-1wgh.3.24). Fix: state the evaluation point.
